verdict.rationale: Retell's AI QA feature automatically evaluates sampled calls against configured rules/metrics scoring hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage, and Conductor can inspect AI QA cohorts and explain low-scoring calls, directly matching the story of automatic scoring, failure flagging, and resolution analysis. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of AI QA accuracy and no detail on how 'resolution' specifically is flagged beyond sentiment/tool-usage metrics.
